newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Three coal miners killed in Ukrainian pit.
newsitem.headline: Three coal miners killed in Ukrainian pit.

text.p: Three miners were killed in a tunnel collapse in Ukraine's eastern Donbass coalfield apparently caused by a gas explosion, officials said on Thursday.

Murtazi Churadze, the Head of Safety Inspection in Donetsk region, told Reuters the accident had happened on Tuesday at Vladimir Lenin mine in the town of Gorlivka, some 60 km (40 miles) north-east of Donetsk.
"Rescue workers retrieved the first body today but they are still unable to retrieve two others," Churadze said. "All three were definitely killed."
Churadze said the reasons for the collapse were being investigated but that it was likely to have been caused by exploding methane gas.
The accident takes the number of fatalities in Ukraine's coal-mining industry to 110 since the begining of the year.

In a separate accident earlier this week, two teenage boys died from burns sustained in a gas explosion in a coal mine in the eastern city of Luhansk, where they were searching for scrap metal to sell. The third boy was in critical condition at a local hospital.
